meta.name: runway
meta.description: Generate and transform video and images with Runway models via inference.sh CLI. Models: Gen-4.5, Gen-4 Turbo, Aleph 2.0, Act-Two, Gen-4 Image, Gen-4 Image Turbo. Capabilities: text-to-video, image-to-video, 2-10s duration, video-to-video transformation with keyframe guidance, character performance transfer from a reference video, text-to-image with tagged reference images. Use for: cinematic clips, animating stills, restyling footage, reframing aspect ratio, character animation, consistent characters across images. Triggers: runway, runwayml, runway gen 4, gen-4, gen 4.5, gen-4.5, gen-4 turbo, runway aleph, aleph 2, act-two, act two, runway act, runway image, gen-4 image, runway video, performance transfer

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。
